about-rays-of-wisdom-society.html.title: About Rays of Wisdom Society
about-rays-of-wisdom-society.html.desc: Rays of Wisdom Society is a Delhi based registered non-profit organization, committed to establish and propagate the wisdom behind ancient rituals and practices. Rays of Wisdom Society (Regd. no. 54348/ 80 g) has beenrecognized officially by the Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India as an Outstanding Category organization.

productions.html.title: Rays of Wisdom Productions
productions.html.desc: Reela Hota’s spiritual leanings and long association with her ashram of her spiritual guru Paramahamsa Satyananda Saraswati, prompted her to deviate from the usual dance presentations of mythological themes and present spiritual philosophy instead. This pioneering work was highly appreciated by critics and audiences alike.

cultural-event-management.html.desc: Rays of Wisdom Society has been specially commissioned to produce events for International Conferences by the different ministries of the central Government of India. Our USP is while we showcase the varied classical and folk forms of India, the central theme of spirituality, the core of Indian traditional lifestyle, runs throughout the presentations.
